# Brest Control
> **Reminder**: This document is intended for use by air traffic controllers on the VATSIM network only and is exclusively for flight simulation purposes. It shall not be used for real-world air traffic control operations.
{.is-warning}

Brest Area Control Centre provides en-route air traffic control services within the upper airspace of north-western France. It also manages the sectors serving the major airports located within its area of responsibility.

![ccr_lfrr_sfl195-fl660.png](/doc-atc/lfrr/acc/ccr_lfrr_sfl195-fl660.png =75%x){.align-center}

The Centre position may be split into four primary sectors: **East (E)**, **South (S)**, and **West (W)**.

When the Centre position is operated as a single sector, the **Bandbox** sector assumes responsibility for all sectors described above.

In addition, during events or as operationally required, individual upper sectors may be opened and provide ATS within their respective vertical limits.

## Control Positions and Limitations
> **Brest Control** is an unrestricted position. Nevertheless, controllers are strongly encouraged to familiarize themselves with this documentation before providing the position.<br>
When no approach positions are staffed, Brest Control shall provide ATS to the underlying aerodromes in accordance with the top-down principle.
{.is-info}

```diagram

```


> The **East**, **South**, and **West** sector shall not be opened independently. It may only be operated when **LFRR_CTR** is online.
{.is-danger}
